user.title: Connect to UniFi Protect
user.description: Enter the address and a local Protect account (created on the console itself, not a Ubiquiti cloud login).

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the NVR. Check the host and port.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. See the logs for details.

abort.already_configured: This UniFi Protect NVR is already configured.

init.title: Saved clips
init.description: Saved clips are full-resolution copies of Protect events, kept outside the NVR so they outlive its retention. Leave the folder empty to keep them under the Home Assistant config folder (they are then included in Home Assistant backups). A folder you enter must already exist; a marker file is placed in it, and saving pauses whenever the folder is found without it (for example, a disk that is not mounted).

data.save_pre_roll: Seconds to keep before the detection
data.save_post_roll: Seconds to keep after the detection
data.save_min_free_gb: Free space to keep in reserve (GB)
data.trash_days: Days to keep removed clips before deleting them
data.flag_in_protect: Also flag saved events in Protect
data.remove_admin_only: Only administrators can remove saved clips

data_description.saved_dir: An absolute path as seen by Home Assistant, for example /media/protect_saved.
data_description.flag_in_protect: Marks the event with Protect's flag so it is easy to find in the Protect app. The flag alone does not stop Protect deleting the footage.

error.dir_missing: That folder does not exist. Create it (or mount the disk) first.
error.dir_not_writable: Home Assistant cannot write to that folder.
